title: service-automation: a refusal met inside a `try_catch` catch region is dropped — the flow caller gets the catch-region failure as text without `innerRefusal` / `userMessage`
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① a product defect measured beside a ruled card, by the #27743 dev (PR #27872, os-dev-report 6513464095, out-of-scope finding 1). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

**Business reason.** #27743 (PR #27872) makes a refusal met inside a `try_catch` try region with no catch region reach the flow's caller with its structured members. When the catch region itself meets a refusal, the caller still gets only text, so the console cannot show the business message.

## Measured (engine.execute, on PR #27872's head)

A `try_catch` with try = [`create_record`] and catch = [`create_record`], both refused by a validation rule: the run ends `failed` with `Node guard failed: try_catch guard: catch region failed — Node b failed: create_record(…) failed: Amount must be positive`; `innerRefusal` and `userMessage` are absent.

## Where

`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/try-catch-node.ts`, the catch-region failure return. The existing carriage (`readCarriedRefusal` of the catch error) is the same one-line shape PR #27872 uses for the no-catch path; no new vocabulary.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The catch-region failure carries the refusal it met, pinned; the `inner-refusal.ts` header's carrier list updated.

## Dedupe

Read the open `domain:server` titles for `try_catch`, `catch region`, `innerRefusal`: only #27743 (which covers the no-catch path and resume). **New.**

Links back: #27743, PR #27872, #27601

Blocked-by: #27872
